name: JDC Metal
description: Complete web platform for a metal and PVC joinery company. Online quote management, configurable product catalog, Google Calendar synchronized appointments, multi-role dashboard and project tracking.
highlights: Multi-step quote system with automatic price calculation
Appointment management with Google Calendar synchronization
Client / admin / craftsman dashboard with differentiated roles
Project tracking with photos and statuses
Automatic travel cost calculation by geolocation

name: Project CLI
description: Python command-line tool to manage, organize and visualize all your projects (active, paused, completed, abandoned) from the terminal.
highlights: Project management via CLI with statuses, tags and priorities
Automatic folder scanning to import all your git repos
Colorful and interactive display with Rich
TUI dashboard (fullscreen text) for visual navigation
Advanced Git status integration (status, branch, commits)
Support for many useful commands (list, add, stale, stats…)

name: VraithUI
description: Minimalist and themable Tailwind CSS plugin with 51 components, 16 themes and full TypeScript support. Design system inspired by daisyUI with semantic tokens, runtime helpers and integrated accessibility.
highlights: 51 UI components (buttons, forms, cards, modals, etc.)
Full TypeScript support with type definitions
Zero runtime CSS - pure styles without JavaScript

name: CRM-Forma
description: Complete CRM designed for independent trainers and training centers. Comprehensive training activity management, from prospecting to billing, with integrated Qualiopi compliance.
highlights: Multi-user management with roles and permissions

name: VraithUI Portfolio
description: Interactive portfolio inspired by modern code editors (Neovim/Cursor). Immersive interface with cyberpunk theme system, integrated console, command palette and custom markdown parser.

name: Bakery App
description: Modern e-commerce application for bakery with online ordering system, inventory management, QR codes for order validation, and complete admin dashboard.
highlights: QR code system for order validation

name: Nihon
description: Online manga library with lending and management system. Platform for browsing, searching and borrowing manga with responsive interface and GSAP animations.

name: PokeAPIGame
description: Complete interactive Pokédex with Pokémon Battle Royale mini-game. Advanced search, type filters, favorites system, and turn-based combat with damage calculations based on real stats.
highlights: Search with autocompletion and keyboard navigation

name: blog-T
description: Blog-T is a personal publishing platform built with Nuxt 3 (TypeScript) and Bun. It features a WYSIWYG editor, image management, and a calming interface. The project uses SQLite for development and PostgreSQL for production.

name: Chess Master
description: The chess-master project is a chess learning app built with Next.js and TypeScript. It features an interactive board powered by chess.js, allowing users to make legal moves and track their history. The app is currently in its foundation phase.

name: Fitness App
description: Fitness-app is a solo RPG fitness app built around the ROOKIE PATH programme, tracking bodyweight exercises and hydration. It's built with Expo (React Native) for the mobile app and FastAPI + SQLAlchemy for the backend.

name: Png2webp Converter
description: png2webp-converter is a command-line tool that converts PNG images to WebP format with optimal compression. It is compatible with Linux and Windows and uses the FFmpeg library.

name: Portfolio React
description: Portfolio Angéline Gillot - React Edition is a modern portfolio built with Vite and React 19. It features a mystical and celestial visual identity inspired by a fantasy universe. The project uses React 19.2.0, Vite 7.2.2, and SASS/SCSS for styles.

name: Protocol Redline
description: protocol_redline is a cyberpunk roguelike deck-builder for Android built with React 19, TypeScript, and Zustand. It features a hidden network layer, deck-building, and combat mechanics. The project is structured to separate game logic from UI.

name: Second Brain
description: second-brain generates and audits an Obsidian second brain from the local machine. It is built with Python and uses the uv library for execution. The project provides a set of commands to initialize, migrate, and sync data with the Obsidian vault.

name: Securescan
description: SecureScan is a web platform that aggregates results from multiple open-source security tools against submitted codebases. It maps findings to OWASP Top 10:2025 and proposes fixes. Built with Go, Fiber, SvelteKit, and PostgreSQL.

name: Symfony Auth Starter
description: Symfony Auth Starter is a package that scaffolds complete authentication into a Symfony application with one command. It generates authentication controllers, forms, and templates, and supports Google OAuth. Built with PHP 8.1+ and Symfony 6.4 or 7.x.
